# Kaydo

> Kaydo is a private app for a family's memories: photos, videos, voice memos,
> letters, journals, recipes and scrapbooks, shared with the family and no one
> else. It is free, carries no ads, does not use families' content for AI
> training, and is open source (MIT).

Each family gets its own address at `your-name.kaydo.app`. The family's admins
sign in with email and password and post. The rest of the inner circle,
grandparents for instance, open the family feed with one shared family password,
without an account or an app to install; journals, the Vault and recipes stay
with the admins. Photos, videos, memories and journal entries can be downloaded
at any time. Kaydo is in English and German, and installs on phones and
desktops as an app.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://kaydo.app/): What Kaydo is, and how to claim a family address.
- [Kaydo auf Deutsch](https://kaydo.app/de): The same page in German.
- [Demo](https://kaydo.app/demo): A fictional demo family to look around in, without an account.
- [Sign up](https://kaydo.app/signup): Create a family space.
- [Log in](https://kaydo.app/login): Sign in to an existing family space.

## Features

- [Moments & Memories](https://kaydo.app/#features): A private feed of photos, videos and voice memos, daily moments, and a timeline by season and "on this day".
- [Best of the month](https://kaydo.app/#features): On the 1st, last month comes back as a story set to music, put together from what the family wrote. No photo is analysed.
- [The Vault](https://kaydo.app/#features): Time capsules of letters, voice notes, photos and videos for one child or the whole family. They open on a chosen date, at a milestone, or, as a legacy, a year after their writer last checked in.
- [Letters & Journals](https://kaydo.app/#features): Letters and a journal for each child, with a printable poster of the sky at the moment they were born.
- [Recipe Tree](https://kaydo.app/#features): Family recipes with their versions and forks across generations.
- [Digital Scrapbook](https://kaydo.app/#features): Drag-and-drop pages of photos, stickers and notes, exported as a PDF or ordered as a printed book.
- [Highlight videos](https://kaydo.app/#features): Short films made from the family's photos, shared to the feed or downloaded.
- [Collages](https://kaydo.app/#features): 14 layouts for the family's photos.
- [Our Year](https://kaydo.app/#features): A recurring look back for a couple, visible to the two of them only.
- [Data export](https://kaydo.app/#features): A ZIP of every photo and video, with memories and journal entries as structured data.

## Privacy & security

- [Privacy commitments](https://kaydo.app/#privacy): No ads, no AI training, no data selling.
- [Security](https://kaydo.app/#security): Photos, videos, voice memos, memories, journals, recipes, scrapbooks and Vault capsules are encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the browser before they are uploaded, so the servers store ciphertext. The family's key is kept on the server, in the family's own record, so Kaydo is not zero-knowledge. A printed book is the one exception: a print shop can only print what it can read, so Kaydo says so before it makes the print file, and deletes the file after 30 days.

## Pricing

- Kaydo is free, with no credit card required. Only a printed book costs money, paid to the print shop (Peecho) directly.
